checks.note: The excerpt, locator (paragraph 9), citations, rationale, limitations and outcome all check out. The problem is the proposition, 'Microsoft has begun partnering with AI startups other than OpenAI.' It leaves out the two-week window (Feb 15–29, 2024) that the contract relies on, and 'has begun' reads as the first such partnership ever. The payload's own rationale and limitations, citing the Nov 2023 Inworld deal (e7), say that reading isn't supported. Suggested wording: Microsoft entered a new partnership with an AI startup other than OpenAI in the two weeks before Feb 29, 2024.
